extraction_notes: The datasheet title is S8050 J3Y, identifies the device as an NPN transistor, and gives the SOT-23 pinout as 1 = base, 2 = emitter, 3 = collector. The manufacturer string is preserved as TDSEMIC.

The printed marking is J3Y. The classification table gives rank J as hFE = 300-400; this bin statement has no separate test condition. It was not substituted for the electrical-characteristics hFE bounds or treated as a typical plotted point.

Curve points are sparse manual digitizations of visible plotted traces on p. 2. No interpolation between source points was used. Plotted mA, mV, pF, and MHz quantities were converted to SI units A, V, F, and Hz.

The electrical-characteristics table gives hFE minimum 120 and maximum 400 at IC = 50 mA, VCE = 1 V, and hFE minimum 50 at IC = 500 mA, VCE = 1 V. Guaranteed bounds remain minimum or maximum source_kind.

The electrical-characteristics table gives VCE(sat) maximum 0.6 V and VBE(sat) maximum 1.2 V at IC = 500 mA, IB = 50 mA. The plotted saturation curves are typical beta = 10 curves at TA = 25 degC and 100 degC.

Cobo and Cibo have no scalar electrical-characteristics table entries; the scalar fields use digitized typical values from the p. 2 Cob/Cib plot at VCB = 1 V and VEB = 1 V respectively. The plot states f = 1 MHz, IE = 0 / IC = 0, and TA = 25 degC.
The p. 1 maximum-ratings table also gives VCBO = 40 V, VEBO = 5 V, IC continuous = 0.5 A, PC = 0.3 W, and Tj = 150 degC; the strict schema exposes only VCEO among these limits.
